alternatives.note: MTF indistinguishable from gaussian; cross-pair PSNR tie (<0.2 dB), lens has better CI (39/50 vs 37/50) and better zero-crossing match (4/5 pairs); not promoted because SKILL swap rule requires >=5 dB

analysis.rationale: 5 support pairs consistently show a single mild deterministic smoothing step: block_boundary 0.998-1.008 (no JPEG), mean_shift -0.4..-0.5/255, variance_ratio 0.90-0.99, chroma_ratio 0.97-0.99, sigma_prior 0.37-0.74 (no noise), unique_G 219-256 (no quantization). gm_ratio 0.446-0.723 with slight spectral-slope steepening (1.03-1.06) => mild blur; slope-based severity 1 (gm-based sev4 rejected). Primary blur_gaussian:1 PSNR 29.21 dB / CI 6/10 on pair 0, support pairs 30.64/26.01/26.35/25.55 dB (CI 37/50); alternative blur_lens:1 29.05 dB / CI 7/10 (support 30.68/25.87/26.40/25.59, CI 39/50). No candidate >40 dB: peeled residual remains structured (spatial_corr 0.86-0.89) and target overshoot (0.49) is systematically above all sims, so the true kernel is slightly sharper/ringier than any x_distortion severity-1 blur; exact reproduction unattainable => UNCERTAIN, training PSNR should arbitrate primary vs lens.
